prompt: A single tower arcology, every floor a different district.

card.name: The Stacked City

site.text: A single enormous tower arcology rising from level ground, with every floor a different district of the city.

style.text: Layered vertical city; each district has its own palette and lighting, tied together by a cohesive tower shell of stone, glass and iron.

purpose.text: A self-contained vertical city housing homes, markets, farms, crafts and civic life in one tower.

card.interpretation: You asked for one tower that holds a whole city. I read the site as a single huge tower on flat ground, with style left open: each floor gets its own look inside a shared shell. Purpose is a self-sufficient vertical city, so the program is the tower itself (the landmark) plus the district floors it contains.
assumptions: Size XL, since a whole city is stacked in one tower.
Districts chosen: market, residential, farm, workshop, garden/temple, observatory.
Density high, as the vertical city is packed.
Claim radius 64 is ample for one tower footprint.

program.notes: The whole city: a tall tower with stacked floors, each a distinct district, linked by central stairs and shafts. Designed as one structure with a glass-crowned top.
Entrance plaza at the tower base, leads to the central stairwell.
Stalls, shops and a tavern ring under lanterns.
Dense rows of small apartments along corridors.
Crop beds, water channels, glowstone grow lights.
Open-air garden and chapel near the top.
